title: Publish reproducible reports and append experimental lab notes
description:
## Scope

Provide offline report commands, figures, text-free result bundles and artifact checksums, an experiment inventory, and an article with hypothesis, investigation, results, and limitations. Append dated lab notes instead of rewriting the historical Few-Shot-Jev experiment as product documentation; link evidence to Decision-Flywheel feature issues.

## Definition of done

A clean offline replay reproduces published aggregates; all claimed effects link to plans and result artifacts; a study may be published once completed without waiting for the entire model matrix.

## Companion-project coordination

- [Decision-Flywheel](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-5ac13e11-6bd8-5787-8136-8f936b5930f8`.

These are cross-repository references; local Kanbus blocked-by relationships encode prerequisites within this repository.

comments.text:
**Owner redirect, 2026-10-01.** Priorities moved to the Unified Decision Flywheel: initiative `decision-flywheel-evaluations-258cd418-2a73-447b-9c78-5073fbf42959`, design `studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md`. The large static Jev selection-by-size study is complete and published: `studies/INITIAL_JEV_RESULTS.md` (commits 44e14e1, 7068ded). Demonstration-ordering and Jev/Kev/Laya cross-model comparisons are **deferred, not cancelled** (Laya and Kev cannot take few-shot context). No spend is approved for this work.

Done so far: the initial study is published with hypothesis, design, results and limits (`studies/INITIAL_JEV_STUDY.md`, `INITIAL_JEV_RESULTS.md`, text-free `results/*.summary.json`) and the experiment inventory (`studies/PRIOR_EXPERIMENTS.md`).

Remaining before this can close: a recorded clean offline replay (`make report` from the text-free observations) that reproduces the published aggregates. No such replay is recorded on this board. The ordering and model-matrix reports are deferred. Kept open at low priority.
